parts.name: Tread bracket, open side
parts.bends: 1 bend, 90 deg toward the outside face: seat tab off the top edge
parts.notes: every tread (4 lower + 7 upper); west side of the upper flight, north side of the lower flight. 2 x 7/16 bolt holes into the stringer, 3 x 11/32 holes in the seat for 5/16 x 1 1/2 lags up into the tread.

parts.name: Tread bracket, wall side (mirror)
parts.bends: 1 bend, 90 deg toward the outside face: seat tab off the top edge
parts.notes: mirror image of the open side part. every tread (4 lower + 7 upper).

parts.name: Floor shoe under the lower stringer (a pocket)
parts.bends: 1 bend, 118 deg: the wall folds up and back over the base to lie on the stringer's sloped top face (61.7 deg pocket)
parts.notes: the lower stringer's level foot stands on the base and its toe sits in the bend; the wall lies on the tube's top face. One 3/8 through bolt square through the wall and the tube (about 4 3/4 in, crush sleeve inside, nut on the tube's underside). Three 3/8 slab anchors (1/2 in holes): two in the wings beside the tube at the west end, one in the east tab. Nothing shares a bracket bolt.

parts.name: Stringer top clip, west side (both flights)
parts.bends: 1 bend, 90 deg (west and east are mirror images)
parts.notes: one pair at each stringer top (upper on the balcony head beam, lower on the landing header). Tube leg hole is a 1 in VERTICAL SLOT: one through bolt across the stringer (crush sleeve inside). Other leg bolts through the beam.

parts.name: Stringer top clip, east side (both flights)
parts.bends: 1 bend, 90 deg (west and east are mirror images)
parts.notes: one pair at each stringer top (upper on the balcony head beam, lower on the landing header). Tube leg hole is a 1 in VERTICAL SLOT: one through bolt across the stringer (crush sleeve inside). Other leg bolts through the beam.

parts.name: Upper stringer post saddle (seat, legs down the post, cheeks up the stringer, tabs to the landing beam)
parts.bends: 6 bends, all 90 deg: the 2 legs DOWN (a U over the post top), the 2 cheeks UP (a U round the stringer), and a tab off each cheek's south edge bent OUT, away from the stringer (bend the tabs before the cheeks)
parts.notes: seat 4.50 x 3.50 in outside; legs 3 in wide, 3.75 in outside, one 3/8 through bolt across the post; cheeks 2.25 in tall outside, one 3/8 through bolt across the stringer (crush sleeve inside); tabs 2.25 in out x 1.80 in tall, one 3/8 bolt each through the landing's north beam. Replaces round 5's foot clips.

parts.name: Post base plate (upper stringer post)
parts.notes: 7 x 7 in, corners R 0.75. Four 1/2 in holes at the corners for 3/8 wedge anchors. COUNTERSINK the two 13/32 in holes (2.45 in each side of centre) from the BOTTOM face (82 deg, 3/8 flat head): the screws go up through the plate into the two clip angles (cut from stock L 3 x 2 x 3/8, long leg up, 3 in long, hole 0.95 in from the heel; two 3/8 through bolts cross the 3 x 3 post and both clips), nuts on top; put them in before the plate is anchored. Round 12: the two rail posts have their own one piece base.

parts.name: Rail post base (foot post and corner newel), one piece
parts.bends: 2 bends, both 90 deg UP toward you with the drawing seen from above (north up, east to the right): the west tab and the north tab. Both parts are identical (not mirrored).
parts.notes: base 6.12 x 6.12 in outside, tabs 5.85 in tall outside (2 in wide). Three 1/2 in holes for 3/8 wedge anchors on the south and east flanges (the side that lifts under the rail load). Two 7/16 holes in each tab for 3/8 grade 5 through bolts across the post (crush sleeve inside); drill the post through the tab holes on site, the two tabs' holes are at different heights so the bolts pass each other. Grind a small 45 deg bevel on the post's bottom outside edge on the two tab faces so it sits down past the bend radius. Replaces the plate plus two clip angles under these two posts.

parts.name: Balcony corner plate (south west newel and north west post)
parts.bends: 1 bend, 90 deg: the flange folds under the end beam. The two are mirror images: bend ONE UP and ONE DOWN (same flat)
parts.notes: on the inside face of the post and the end beam (south west: the south beam's north face; north west: the north arm's south face). Two 3/8 grade 5 through bolts across the post (crush sleeve inside); two 3/8 bolts up through the flange and the beam (crush sleeves), nuts in counterbores on the underside of the oak. Replaces the round 3 L plates: nothing on the stair side.

parts.name: Clip angle 2 in wide, 1 3/4 legs
parts.notes: PLACEHOLDER for an engineer: at the landing and balcony frame corners, including the ledger and north arm ends on the north east post. Round 7: the knee braces use gusset plates instead. Round 11b: the balcony has no west beam, so no clips there.

parts.name: Knee frame gusset, top
parts.notes: flat: south frame: brace top to the head beam (2 bolts in the beam, 1 in the brace). South frame: on the brace's north face; north frame: on the north face. 3/8 through bolts with crush sleeves.

parts.name: Knee frame gusset, foot
parts.notes: flat: both frames: brace foot to the wall post (2 in the post, 1 in the brace); a triangle whose lower edge follows the post's 45 deg foot cut. South frame: on the brace's north face; north frame: on the north face. 3/8 through bolts with crush sleeves.

parts.name: Knee frame gusset, corner
parts.notes: flat: south frame: wall post top to the head beam's end, an L plate (2 bolts in the post, 2 in the beam, so it cannot pivot). South frame: on the brace's north face; north frame: on the north face. 3/8 through bolts with crush sleeves.

parts.name: Knee frame gusset, north top
parts.notes: flat: north frame: brace top to the north arm's west end and the north west post (the post's 2 bolts are the corner plate's, 1 in the brace). South frame: on the brace's north face; north frame: on the north face. 3/8 through bolts with crush sleeves.

parts.name: Rail strap 1 1/4 x 4.83 (foot post)
parts.notes: flat strap on a post's side face: the hole nearest an end takes a 1/4-20 bolt through the rail and a 1/4 in spacer (the rail sits 1/4 in in from the post face), the other two take 1/4-20 bolts through the post. The lower rail over the foot post: its plumb depth is 3.16 in, so the rail hole is further from the post holes.

parts.name: Rail strap 1 1/4 x 4.00
parts.notes: flat strap on a post's side face: the hole nearest an end takes a 1/4-20 bolt through the rail and a 1/4 in spacer (the rail sits 1/4 in in from the post face), the other two take 1/4-20 bolts through the post. Lies along the rail into the post where a rail ends on a post, plumb where it runs over a post top.
